subject: general
question: An electric heater of resistance 50 uses a current of 3 A. Determine the heat generated in 20 seconds.
solution:
__**Explanation:**__

**Q = I² × R × t**

Where:

 
• **Q** = Heat generated (in joules)
 
• **I** = Current (in amperes)
 
• **R** = Resistance (in ohms)
 
• **t** = Time (in seconds)

**Step 1:** Substitute the given values into the formula:

 
• **I** = 3 A
 
• **R** = 50 Ω
 
• **t** = 20 s

**Q = (3 × 3) × 50 × 20**

**Q = 9 × 50 × 20**

**Q = 450 × 20**

**Q = 9000 J**
